_about: The ship tab of the airship screen. sheet: the drawing under the layers (pack path; web/art/blueprint_base.png is the base barge of tools/web_art.py). parts: the details that buildings bring, each its own layer on the drawing and its own model in 3D. building: the level without the prefix that brings it, null while the mod has no such building yet; enabled: connected on the page now (false: only the data is ready, the step to come is to set it true). Drawing layers: pencil, build, ink in web/art/layers.json or data/crew_ui_art.json (null: not drawn yet); turns_at: where the turns left are written while it is built, in units of the drawing (1040 x 760). model.part: build/web/models/<part>.gltf (tools/web_export.py); model.hides: nodes of the base hull it replaces; source: where the model comes from.
